description: This file defines the final class 'Utils' within the GuzzleHttp namespace, containing various utility methods for type description, header parsing, resource handling, handler selection, system CA bundle detection, header normalization, proxy host checking, JSON encoding/decoding, time measurement, and IDN URI conversion.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various common tasks such as type description, header parsing, resource management, handler selection, CA bundle retrieval, header normalization, host proxy checks, JSON processing, time measurement, and URI manipulation.

methods.name: describeType
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string about the type and class of the provided input.

methods.name: headersFromLines
methods.description: Parses header lines into an associative array mapping header names to their values.

methods.name: debugResource
methods.description: Returns a resource suitable for debugging output based on the input value or system configuration.

methods.name: chooseHandler
methods.description: Selects and creates an appropriate HTTP handler based on the environment capabilities.

methods.name: defaultUserAgent
methods.description: Generates a default User-Agent string for Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: defaultCaBundle
methods.description: Detects and returns the path to the default CA bundle for the system; deprecated for recent PHP versions.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderKeys
methods.description: Converts header names in an array to lowercase keys, preserving original casing as values.

methods.name: isHostInNoProxy
methods.description: Checks if a host matches any pattern in a no-proxy list, considering wildcards and domain suffixes.

methods.name: jsonDecode
methods.description: Decodes JSON strings into PHP data structures, throwing exceptions on errors.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes PHP data into JSON string, throwing exceptions on errors.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current time as a float, using hrtime if available, otherwise microtime.

methods.name: idnUriConvert
methods.description: Converts the host part of a UriInterface to ASCII-compatible encoding if needed, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from server or environment, with support for CLI.
